info.scriptSrcText: property this, Xpos, swellAngle, radians, Ypos, mapXPos, survivorDelay, thisMember, Xvel, cableGuy, pickupState, ThisWidth, thisHalfHeight, grabCount, distToHQ, pickupID, pickupTile, pickupMaster, loopWidth, loopX, sinList, sinListPointerglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gTileIDList, gCableItem, gCableLength, gRescueCount, gRescuedList, gScore, gPickupList, gfuelPercent, gSceneryList, gDamagePercenton beginSprite  radians = float(PI / 180)  sinList = []  repeat with i = 1 to 180    sinList.add(30 * sin(i * 2 * radians))  end repeat  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  this.locZ = 60  case this.memberNum of    84:      pickupID = #TREASURE    85:      pickupID = #FUEL    86:      pickupID = #TOOLS  end case  loopWidth = gTileIDList.count * 128  loopX = gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.5  Xpos = float(this.locH)  Ypos = float(this.locV)  Xvel = 0  mapXPos = Xpos - 256  survivorDelay = 0  swellAngle = 0  cableGuy = sprite(6)  pickupState = #ONGROUND  pickupTile = 0  grabCount = 0  gPickupList.add(this)endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    case pickupState of      #NULL:        this.locH = -1000        this.locV = -1000      #ONGROUND:        Xpos = Xpos + gXVel + gXOffset + Xvel        if Xpos > loopX then          Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth        end if        if Xpos < -loopX then          Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth        end if        sinListPointer = sinListPointer + 1        if sinListPointer > sinList.count then          sinListPointer = 1        end if        this.locV = Ypos + sinList[sinListPointer]        this.locH = Xpos        if (this.locH > 0) or (this.locH < 512) then          diffX = abs(this.locH - cableGuy.locH)          diffY = abs(this.locV - cableGuy.locV)          if (diffX <= 10) and (diffY <= 20) then            if (gCableItem = 0) and (gCableLength >= 50) then              pickupState = #ONCABLE              case pickupID of                #TREASURE:                  puppetSound(4, member(15, "Sfx"))                #FUEL:                  puppetSound(4, member(10, "Sfx"))                #TOOLS:              end case              gCableItem = 1            end if          else            grabCount = 0          end if        end if      #ONCABLE:        this.loc = cableGuy.loc + point(0, 10)        if gCableLength = 0 then          gCableItem = 0          pickupState = #NULL          case pickupID of            #TREASURE:              gScore = gScore + 1234              puppetSound(3, member(16, "Sfx"))            #FUEL:              if gfuelPercent > 0 then                gScore = gScore + 10                gfuelPercent = 100                puppetSound(3, member(19, "Sfx"))              end if            #TOOLS:              if gDamagePercent < 100 then                gScore = gScore + 10                gDamagePercent = 0                if gDamagePercent < 0 then                  gDamagePercent = 0                end if                puppetSound(3, member(18, "Sfx"))              end if          end case          gPickupList.add(this)        end if    end case  end ifend
